title: Install Cursor and open your project
goal: Get the Cursor editor installed and your project folder open in it

steps.say: Go to cursor.com/download and press the download button for macOS.
steps.find: the macOS download button on cursor.com/download

steps.say: Open the downloaded file and drag Cursor into your Applications folder.
steps.find: the Cursor icon and the Applications folder in the window

steps.say: Open Cursor from Applications or Launchpad. macOS may ask you to confirm opening an app from the internet.

instead.say: If macOS blocks it, open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and press Open Anyway.

steps.say: Sign in with your Cursor account when it asks. You can make a free one at cursor.com.
steps.find: the sign in button in Cursor

steps.say: In the menu bar choose File, then Open Folder, and pick your project's folder.
steps.find: File in the menu bar, then Open Folder

steps.say: Back in Companion, press Change folder and choose the same folder, so Companion and Cursor look at the same project.
steps.find: the Change folder button in Companion's card
